• Garantire il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e integrare le misure di garanzia della qualità nel processo di produzione
• Istituzione e sviluppo di un sistema di controllo e reporting basato su indicatori chiave per la misurazione del successo e la priorità delle iniziative di miglioramento
• Leader professionale e disciplinare del team Operazioni Eccellenza e promozione delle competenze magre e di processo all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Chiudere la cooperazione trasversale con la produzione, l'ingegneria, la logistica, l'acquisto, la gestione della qualità e l'eccellenza aziendale

descriptionByLocale.en:
As Head of Operations Excellence (m/f/d), you are responsible for the strategic and operational development of the production and process landscape. They drive the transformation towards efficient and standardized production and ensure the sustainable increase in quality, productivity and delivery reliability while complying with the highest safety and quality requirements. Specifically, you take on the following tasks:
• Development and implementation of an Operations Excellence Roadmap in line with corporate strategy
• Further development of the production organisation from single to small series production and development of an integrated production system
• Identification and realization of optimization potential along the entire value chain using established lean methods
• Introduction and sustainable anchoring of standardized processes and control of the continuous improvement process
• Analysis and reduction of lead times, error rates and rework costs to increase efficiency and quality
• Ensuring compliance with normative requirements and integrating quality assurance measures into the production process
• Establishment and further development of a key performance indicator-based control and reporting system for measuring success and prioritizing improvement initiatives
• Professional and disciplinary leadership of the Operations Excellence team and promotion of lean and process competencies within the organization
• Close cross-divisional cooperation with production, engineering, logistics, purchasing, quality management and business excellence WHAT YOU SHOULD BUILD
• Successfully completed study of mechanical engineering, production engineering, industrial engineering or a comparable discipline
• Several years of professional experience in the manufacturing industry and relevant experience in a comparable function
• Demonstrate success in the introduction and further development of Lean and Operations Excellence systems, ideally in single or small series production
• In-depth knowledge of Lean Management, Six Sigma and continuous improvement methods
• Experience with complex manufacturing processes as well as safe handling of ERP and key figures systems
• Knowledge of relevant quality and industry standards, preferably EN 9100, AQAP 2110 and ISO 9001
